desc:
LIQUID CENTER: Holiday lights themed box of Gushers Tropical Fruit Flavored Snacks in mini pouches, here for a limited time; Bite into Gushers and the juicy center bursts with yummy liquid

MINI POUCHES: Mini pouches are ready to add to stockings, gift baskets, care packages, and more; Make them the star of a holiday party or kids snack time

GLUTEN FREE: Fruit-flavored, gummy treats are gluten free

KOSHER

CONTAINS: 1 ct
features:
Key Features:

Flavor Variety: Includes two fruity flavors – Tropical and Strawberry.

Juicy Centers: Each bite has a chewy texture with a burst of juicy liquid inside.

Gluten-Free: Suitable for people with gluten sensitivities or preferences.

Gelatin-Free: No gelatin, making it vegetarian-friendly.

Vitamin C Enriched: Provides about 10% of the recommended daily value of Vitamin C per pouch.

Individually Wrapped: Comes in single-serve pouches – perfect for lunchboxes, snacks on the go, or portion control.

Benefits:

Fun & Flavorful Snack: Kids and adults alike enjoy the sweet, juicy taste and texture.

Convenient for Busy Lifestyles: Easy to pack, carry, and eat anywhere.

Supports Dietary Needs: Safe option for those avoiding gluten or gelatin.

Adds Variety to Snack Time: Two flavors in one pack keep snack time interesting.

Boosts Daily Nutrition: Small dose of Vitamin C supports immune health.
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Modified Corn Starch, Fructose, Maltodextrin, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Cottonseed Oil, Glycerin, Grape Juice Concentrate, Citric Acid, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Potassium Citrate, Agar-Agar, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Xanthan Gum, Color (red 40, blue 1, yellows 5 & 6).
